name: authensor-mcp-server
description: Policy enforcement gateway for MCP tool calls, evaluating every tool invocation against declarative YAML policies (allow/deny/escalate-to-human), generating cryptographic hash-chained audit receipts, and including built-in content safety scanning.

rawRecord.description: Policy enforcement gateway for MCP tool calls, evaluating every tool invocation against declarative YAML policies (allow/deny/escalate-to-human), generating cryptographic hash-chained audit receipts, and including built-in content safety scanning.

AUTHENSOR_API_KEY.description: The API key used for authenticating with the control plane and binding to the principal identity.

AUTHENSOR_PRINCIPAL_ID.description: The unique identifier for the agent principal (e.g., 'my-agent').

AUTHENSOR_SHADOW_POLICY_ID.description: Optional policy ID for shadow evaluation testing, allowing you to test new policies alongside active ones without enforcement.

AUTHENSOR_CONTROL_PLANE_URL.description: The URL of the Authensor control plane. Defaults to http://localhost:3000

AUTHENSOR_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: The bootstrap admin token used for initial configuration and admin actions.
